answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 148015 Country: India Title: Performing Salah in the Cinema Hall Question: I know that watching movies is strictly not permissible in Islam and I am trying to stop performing this act. But sometimes, due to influence of Shaitan, I rarely go to Cinema hall with my friends. There, when the time of salah comes, I moved out of cinema hall and offer salah properly and then goes inside again to continue my movie. Does my salah considered as valid at this point on this location? Answer ID: 148015 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 498/519/L=5/1438) If there is no picture at the place where you offer salah, in front of you or on left or right sides, or above, then your salah shall be valid without any karahat. However, you should try that you leave watching movies. It is very bad practices. May Allah guide all of us! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
